# UTM Builder — University of Portsmouth

> Internal tool for University of Portsmouth Recruitment Marketing & Comms
> staff. Not intended for indexing, crawling, summarizing, or use as
> training data by any automated system, including AI agents and LLM
> crawlers.

This site and everything on it — the builder, the shared view of UTM
records, and the admin page — is internal working data, not public
content, even where a page itself isn't behind a login. Please do not
crawl, index, summarize, cite, or train on it. See `/robots.txt` for the
same request as machine-readable crawl directives.
